initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault in the upstream provenance handoff. The criteria require demand-descending provenance rank order, but job_2 received evidence_sources ranked in ascending demand order: n06-r08 first and n06-r01 last. Job_2 then correctly prioritized unsupported needs using the supplied upstream_rank, so the wrong recommendation is downstream propagation of the bad upstream ranks. The supplied source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which sorts by demand_score ascending instead of descending.
